task: Add Exchange read transports (Microsoft Graph primary, EWS/NTLM fallback) with four read operations, a MS_EXCHANGE SettingsTester healthcheck, and four new dependencies.

key_reasoning.reason: Two new transport clients (graph_client, ews_client), a tools module with four read operations and metadata, a SettingsTester handler, and toolkit wiring; new abstractions over two SDKs with different auth models.

Closest pattern is ServiceNow/SharePoint healthcheck tools, which do not cover a two-identity auth model, bounded read-only retries, or error-message sanitisation for secrets and message IDs. No live Exchange environments; NTLM and consent behaviour cannot be proven in CI.
About 3 new source files plus tool metadata and 4+ new test files; modified settings_tester, toolkit, pyproject and lockfile across tools, service and manifest directories.
Four new packages (azure-identity, msgraph-sdk, exchangelib, requests-ntlm) with lockfile regeneration, unverified compatibility with existing pins, and an unresolved msgraph major version.
Tools/service, settings service, dependency infrastructure and two external systems (Graph, EWS); the UI testable flag is a separate repo.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped: security-sensitive credential handling and secret-leak avoidance in error text
Component Scope and Affected Layers reflect integration with new external services

split_recommendation.ordering_note: Graph primary path with shared tools and tester handler first; EWS/NTLM fallback builds on it.

slices.title: Graph transport, read tools and MS_EXCHANGE healthcheck
slices.scope: Add the Graph client with azure-identity and msgraph, the four read operations and their metadata, and the SettingsTester MS_EXCHANGE handler for the oauth_azure path, with the related dependencies and tests.

slices.title: EWS/NTLM fallback transport
slices.scope: Add the exchangelib and requests-ntlm client for the ntlm auth path, wire it into the read operations and the healthcheck, and cover it with mocked tests.
slices.depends_on: Graph transport, read tools and MS_EXCHANGE healthcheck
